decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed extension would not be harmful to neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the site.  It would be in compliance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) C.3.2 (New or Extended Health Facilities), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), and the Residential Extension Guidelines and 'Think Access' Guidelines of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building.)

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the south elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

(Reason.  To prevent overlooking of the nearby premises)
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to doctors surgery.
